name: Sombra de Nariz
algorithm: Nose Shadow — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes nose shadow patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Nose Sombra Detección**: The shadow cast by the nose (primarily on the cheek and upper lip) is detected per frame using luminance gradient analysis. The shadow's shape, direction, and intensity are measured.

2. **Sombra - Lighting Consistencia**: The nose shadow direction should be consistent with the overall scene illumination. The method estimates the light source direction from the nose shadow and cross-validates against other facial shadows (orbital shadows, chin shadow, nasolabial shadows). Inconsistent shadow directions indicate manipulated lighting in the generated face.

3. **Sombra Shape Análisis**: The nose shadow shape should be geometrically consistent with the nose's 3D shape and the light direction. A straight nose bridge casts a different shadow than a curved one. The method checks whether the shadow shape is physically plausible given the detected nose geometry. AI generators may produce shadows that don't correspond to the nose geometry.

4. **Sombra - Pose Dynamics**: As the head rotates, the nose shadow should shift according to the changing angle between the nose and light source. The method tracks shadow position relative to nose landmarks across frames. In deepfakes, shadows may not respond correctly to head rotation — remaining static or moving independently of head pose.

5. **Soft Sombra Rendering**: Natural nose shadows show penumbra (soft edges) whose width depends on the light source size. The method evaluates shadow edge quality — AI generators may produce shadows with incorrect penumbra (too sharp or too soft) or no penumbra gradient, lacking the physical light-shadow relationship.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante nose shadow analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
